question: The original Constitution contained 395 Articles divided into ________ parts.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 22**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Constitution of India is the longest-written constitution** of any sovereign nation in the world.
 
• The** original text of the Constitution contained 395 articles in 22 parts and 8 schedules.**
 
• It **came into effect on January 26, 1950**, the day that India celebrates each year as Republic Day.
 
• The number of articles has since increased to 448 due to 105 amendments. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Important Facts about India Constitution​**

 
 
• It was **adopted on November 26, 1949, **and came into effect on January 26, 1950.
 
• It **draws influences from various constitutions like those of the UK, USA, Ireland, and Australia.**
 
• Dr. B.R. Ambedkar is considered the principal architect of the Constitution.
 
• The Constitution is the **supreme law of India**; any law inconsistent with it is void.
 
• **India has a federal structure with a unitary bias**, giving more power to the central government.
 
• It declares India a secular state, ensuring equality for all religions.
 
• The** Constitution can be amended through a detailed process under Article 368.**
 
• It guarantees Fundamental Rights to citizens and lists Fundamental Duties.
 
• The Preamble declares India as a Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic Republic.
